newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stanbic secures $130 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: Stanbic secures $130 mln loan facility.

text.p: South Africa's Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd said on Tuesday that it had secured a $130 million loan facility from a group of international banks.
The three year facility has been jointly arranged by Chase Investment Bank Ltd, Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft and the Sanwa Bank Ltd.
The deal was priced at 40 basis points over LIBOR (London Interbank Offered Rate).
The loan was originally launched for $100 million, but was heavily oversubscribed with more than $160 million being raised in the market.
Stanbic decided that it would extend the facility to $130 million, resulting in scale-backs for some of the participating banks.
The loan will be used for on-lending to the local corporate and commercial market.
